criteria.criterion: The change description and the code comment/docs (disk.rs module docs, docs/decisions.md entry) name the root cause: the disk guard did not cover the point between the checks and the verifier, and an environment failure there was not separated from a work failure.
criteria.evidence: Read the diff. The disk.rs module docs (lines 15-20) say "The disk guard did not cover the point between the checks and the verifier ... An environment failure there was not separated from a work failure." D142's Root cause bullet says the same, and so does the CHANGELOG Fixed entry. The commit message is Athena's placeholder ("candidate"), so the CHANGELOG and D142 serve as the change description.

criteria.criterion: run/mod.rs calls the shared disk gate (with idle-target sweep) and a workspace write probe immediately before the verifier agent runs, and on failure closes the job with an `environment: low disk` reason, no verification verdict, and the `athena retry` hint, reusing the existing LowDisk text.
criteria.evidence: run/mod.rs lines 2173-2187 call disk::verifier_environment_problem(&self.state, min_free_gb, &id, vsnap.dir(), ui) after the checks and the verifier inputs are built, and before verifier_invocation and the agent loop. That function runs `gate` (the same function disk_gate now wraps, sweep included) and then write_probe. If either fails, the job closes through self.failure with before_verifier_reason, which starts with LowDisk::text() or LOW_DISK and contains `athena retry {job}`. verification_passed is set to None, and the function returns before closing.verification is set.

criteria.criterion: A new test simulating low free space only after the checks pass (e.g. via ATHENA_FREE_BYTES or a gate seam) shows the job fails with `environment: low disk` before the verifier agent is invoked and records no verifier verdict; run `cargo test --locked` and see that test fail on the base tree and pass on the change.
criteria.evidence: low_disk_after_the_checks_fails_the_job_as_the_environment_before_the_verifier_runs passed when I ran it (6/6 low_disk drain tests ok). Athena's recorded `cargo test --locked` run passed with 1509 tests. The test asserts: the job is Failed, the reason contains 'environment: low disk: 3.0 GB free, 10.0 GB required before the verifier' and the retry hint, the checks line was printed, no verifier line was printed, the verifier script was called 0 times, records hold verification None, and no Verifier invocation was recorded. I did not run the test on the base tree, because the snapshot does not let me change git state. Reading the base disk.rs shows it has no `is_environment_reason`, so the test cannot compile on base. The base also has no gate before the verifier, so the verifier would run and the state/call-count assertions would fail. D142 says the test fails with the call disabled; I did not measure that.

criteria.criterion: A unit test in disk.rs shows the write probe fails on an unwritable/full workspace and succeeds on a normal one, and that the failure is classified as environment, not work, for any job (not one fixed job id); run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core disk`.
criteria.evidence: 8 disk tests passed, including three new ones. the_write_probe_succeeds_in_a_normal_workspace_and_leaves_nothing_behind and the_write_probe_fails_where_nothing_can_be_written use a missing directory and a path that is a file; both fail even for root, so they meet the root-bypass default. the_verifier_environment_check_fails_as_the_environment_for_any_job loops over 3 job ids and checks is_environment_reason against the low-space and unwritable cases, and against two work-failure reasons.

criteria.criterion: With sufficient simulated free space the existing drain and binary tests still pass unchanged; run `cargo test --locked`.
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded `cargo test --locked` passed (1509 tests). The diff adds one test to drain.rs and changes no existing test. binary.rs is not touched.

criteria.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked` all pass.
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded checks on this tree: fmt passed, clippy passed, tests passed (1509 tests ran).

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the pre-verifier environment check.
criteria.evidence: CHANGELOG.md, under Unreleased > Fixed: "The verifier no longer starts in an environment that cannot build or write. Root cause: ..."

findings.summary: The early return before the verifier drops the check results and the check cleanup records already gathered.
findings.evidence: check_runs and cleanup are computed above the new gate but are written only inside the Verification record at line 2377. That record is skipped on the environment failure, so the failed job's records do not show which checks ran or what they cleaned up. A retry reruns the checks, so nothing is wrong, but the evidence is lost.

findings.summary: `is_environment_reason` is used only in tests; no production path (status, introspection) uses it to separate environment failures from work failures.
findings.evidence: A grep for is_environment_reason in crates/ finds only disk.rs tests and tests/drain.rs. In production the two kinds of failure are told apart by the Failed (not Rejected) state and the reason text.

findings.summary: Docs call an unwritable workspace "low disk".
findings.evidence: A write-probe failure caused by permissions or a broken mount is reported as 'environment: low disk: the verifier's workspace cannot be written to (...)'. This is deliberate, to reuse the existing text, but it can mislead when the disk is not actually full.

summary: The change does what was asked. The root cause is that the disk guard did not cover the point between the checks and the verifier. The change fixes it in athena-core by running the shared `gate` (same threshold, same cleanup of idle build directories) and a small write probe in the verifier's snapshot immediately before the verifier agent starts. On failure the job closes as Failed with the retryable `environment: low disk ... before the verifier` reason and the `athena retry` hint; no verifier is invoked and no verdict is recorded. The root cause is named in the disk.rs module docs, D142 and CHANGELOG. I ran the new disk unit tests (8 passed) and the drain low_disk tests (6 passed, including the new end-to-end test where free space drops only once the verifier snapshot exists). Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test runs (1509 tests) passed. I did not run the new test on the base tree because the snapshot does not let me change git state. The base disk.rs shows it would not compile there (no `is_environment_reason`), and the base has no gate before the verifier, so the test's assertions could not hold. All changed files are in the expected deliverables. Two minor follow-ups remain: the early return drops the check results already gathered, and the new classifier is used only in tests. Neither blocks.
